They have also got place to workout. This place motivates you to keep yourself fit and eat as well. They take care all of your needs in food. The cafe is nicely decorated. They have got board games to play also you can draw design or play on the table only with chalk. Also for exercise the place the has different sections apart from the eating area.

We started indulging ourselves with some refreshing juices they were not only refreshing but healthy too. Later we called for soup starter and main course everything was so amazing and perfect in taste we didn’t even feel that we were eating keto food and have totally become a fan of one now. For me the star of the show was the desserts highly recommended to try them out.

It’s a for sure visit place do not forget to put it on your list.

featured_reviews.review_text:

1. Chicken Avacado Salad

4. Better Butter Chicken with Grain-Free Kulcha

6. Chicken Khow Suey

featured_reviews.name: 1TeaspoonLove
featured_reviews.review_text:
This cute new Cafe at colaba which is right under a gym serves gluten free, keto friendly, almost dairy free food also rich in proteins.

Egg and meat eaters have a lot of options to choose from.

Vegetarians have a few but good options to choose from.

I tried a couple of dishes and liked them.

Sweet potato rosti...super thin rosti, perfectly done, so so flavorful. Loved it. Only wish it was a little thick. The portion was too less.

Broccoli Spinach paratha... Loved these crisp and healthy gluten free paratha. The mint chutney was delicious too.

The 5 color salad with kale and fruits... Was quite good and fresh. Loved the dressing. However the cashew cream could have been more creamier and smoother then tiny bits of cashews.

Soy keema with gluten free kulcha... another flavorful and healthy dish. Spicy kheema with soft kulcha.. perfect condition.

Zucchini noodles with vegetable balls and marinara.... Loved the flavors here however the zucchini could have been cooked better. The ballast were a little dry, can be made softer and moist.

Loved the fresh juices.

This place Is perfect for the health freaks and who prefer gluten free food. Definitely worth trying.
